description: This file defines the UserEventHandler class which handles user-related events such as login, logout, account lockout, and account status changes, and records audit trail events accordingly.

classes.name: UserEventHandler
classes.description: Handles user events and records audit trail entries for login, account status changes, and other user-related actions.

methods.name: UserEventHandler
methods.description: Constructor initializing dependencies for audit trail management, HTTP context access, and service provider.

methods.name: LoggedInAsync
methods.description: Records a successful login event for a user.

methods.name: LoggingInFailedAsync
methods.description: Records a failed login attempt for a user.

methods.name: LoggingInFailedAsync (string userName)
methods.description: Records a failed login attempt with only username information.

methods.name: DisabledAsync
methods.description: Records when a user account is disabled.

methods.name: EnabledAsync
methods.description: Records when a user account is enabled.

methods.name: RecordAuditTrailEventAsync
methods.description: Helper method to create and record an audit trail event with user details.

methods.name: LoggingInAsync (string, Action)
methods.description: Placeholder for login process, currently does nothing.

methods.name: LoggingInAsync ()
methods.description: Placeholder for login process, currently returns null.

methods.name: ValidatingLoginAsync
methods.description: Placeholder for login validation, currently returns null.

methods.name: GetCurrentUserName
methods.description: Retrieves the current user's username from HTTP context.

methods.name: GetCurrentUserId
methods.description: Retrieves the current user's ID from HTTP context claims.
